Rina Kaur: Quick kickoff for CircuitFlow case study. Targeting a soft launch Apr 5 and wider push Apr 12. Need quotes, assets, and legal before Apr 3.
Ben Holt: Who is our contact? Is it still Aisha?
Carlos Vega (CS): Yep, Aisha (CTO). She wants a short written Q&A + a 10s b-roll clip of their ops console.
Rina Kaur: Good. Plan: send a 5-question async questionnaire, request logo/headshot/clip, and offer a 20m camera-off call for any clarifications.
Evan Lee (Design): For the hero we need a landscape product screenshot (no PHI) and an alpha palette. Can we get raw PNG and a transparent SVG logo?
Carlos Vega (CS): I'll ask for PNG + SVG. Also confirming the clip can be raw MP4 1080p.
Priya Menon (Legal): For consent, we prefer a short release form. I'll paste the template now.
Priya Menon (Legal): ``
CircuitFlow Release: By providing a written quote and media, you grant Redwood Inference permission to use, edit, and publish the content in marketing materials. Materials will be published under the agreed embargo date.
``
Rina Kaur: Can we have one-click approval for execs? That speeds this up.
Priya Menon (Legal): Yes. We'll route an approval link via our approvals-bot. Final copy will be shared for courtesy review.
Ben Holt: Question about metrics: Aisha mentioned "2.5x throughput" and "~35% reduced infra spend". We need exact phrasing and attribution.
Carlos Vega (CS): Aisha okayed those numbers in the call but will confirm in writing.
media-bot: Drive folder created: https://drive.company/circuitflow-case (auto).
Rina Kaur: Draft Qs (short): 1) What is CircuitFlow in one sentence? 2) What was the technical bottleneck before Redwood? 3) What metrics changed? (please quantify) 4) One sentence on vendor selection reasons. 5) Any advice for teams evaluating inference platforms?
Ben Holt: Add a final "one line hero quote" prompt. Those are key for banners.
Rina Kaur: Added. Sending now.
Carlos Vega (CS): Sent to Aisha. Expect responses Wed.
Evan Lee (Design): If we get responses Wed, I can deliver hero comps + promo cut by Fri.
Rina Kaur: Lead routing note: tag CircuitFlow campaigns in HubSpot as "campaign:CircuitFlowCase". HubSpot then routes to SDRs; if MQL score >=85 route to AE.
hubspot-bot: CircuitFlow tag created and tracking URL: https://app.hubspot/track?utm_campaign=CircuitFlowCase&utm_source=marketing
Ben Holt: Also planning a follow-up webinar Apr 20 with Aisha as panelist. Tentative topic: "Scaling inference for real-time pipelines."
Carlos Vega (CS): Aisha confirmed Apr 20 morning PT works.
Priya Menon (Legal): Reminder: embargo window must include notification to customer and internal embargo holders. Please specify embargo date in the release.
Rina Kaur: Proposed embargo Apr 5 09:00 PT. Good?
Aisha Noor (Customer): Apr 5 09:00 PT works for CircuitFlow. Thanks for making the async option easy.
Ben Holt: Asset checklist for launch: PNG/SVG logo, 1 headshot, 10s b-roll, hero screenshot, 3 pull quotes, short transcript, webinar slide.
Rina Kaur: I'm drafting the case doc now. Will post link once ready. Please keep copy tight (350-450 words) for SAAS blog slot.
media-bot: Transcript uploaded: https://drive.company/circuitflow-case/memo-transcript.txt
Carlos Vega (CS): Aisha provided written confirmations for the two metrics at 15:04. Pasting exact quotes into the doc.
Rina Kaur: Routing to @Priya Menon for legal signoff on quote language.
Priya Menon (Legal): Reviewed and approved. Sending one-click approval link to Aisha now.
hubspot-bot: One-click approval recorded. Aisha approved at 18:07.
Rina Kaur: Embargo set and internal playbook updated. Draft live: https://docs.company/circuitflow-case-draft. Leave comments by Thu 5pm.
Evan Lee (Design): Uploaded hero-v1 and promo-10s: https://drive.company/circuitflow-case/hero-v1.png, https://drive.company/circuitflow-case/promo-10s.mp4
Ben Holt: I'll prep the benchmark sidebar showing throughput vs prior baseline. Carlos, can you validate data points?
Carlos Vega (CS): Validated. Data table attached in Drive.
Rina Kaur: Final check: legal signoff ✅, assets ✅, customer approval ✅, webinar scheduled ✅. Moving to build the launch email + blog schedule.
Ben Holt: Thanks team. We'll sync Mon 9am for final pre-flight. :rocket:
